items.headline: U.S.-Mediated Peace Talks on Ukraine War Resume in Abu Dhabi
items.summary: Delegations from the United States, Ukraine, and Russia are convening in Abu Dhabi on November 10 for two days of trilateral negotiations focused on post-war security guarantees and ending the conflict. The summit comes as G7 foreign ministers meet in Paris to press for diplomatic terms that protect Ukrainian sovereignty and European security.

items.headline: Nvidia Launches Probe Into CEO Jensen Huang Over Foreign Intelligence Concerns

items.headline: Trinity Rodman and Ashley Sanchez Named Finalists for 2026 NWSL MVP Award
items.summary: On November 9, 2026, the National Women's Soccer League officially announced the finalists for its end-of-year awards, headlined by Washington Spirit star Trinity Rodman and Golden Boot winner Ashley Sanchez. The shortlist release officially kicked off the final voting round across players, coaches, media, and fans before the winners are crowned on November 18.

items.headline: "Godzilla Minus Zero" Sets North American Box Office Record for Foreign-Language Live-Action Film
items.summary: Director Takashi Yamazaki's "Godzilla Minus Zero" topped the North American box office with an estimated $31.6 million weekend opening. The release set a new record for the highest opening weekend by a live-action foreign-language movie in North America, outperforming its Oscar-winning predecessor.
